primary_hypothesis: For sufficiently difficult MWIS instances and bounded classical recovery budgets, an AI-selected shallow quantum sampler can generate a set S_Q such that identical downstream recovery produces better solutions than recovery initialized from matched classical sample sets S_C.

levels.LEVEL_1: Quantum-selected subspace advantage under matched sample/recovery budgets
levels.LEVEL_2: End-to-end hybrid QCSC advantage under an explicit compute accounting model
levels.LEVEL_3: Quantum advantage candidate that survives strong adversarial classical challenges and held-out replication

success_criterion: 95% bootstrap CI for paired A_Q excludes zero on held-out instances
